query.User: I am wondering if you have functionality to fetch temperature from different rooms in my house?
query.Assistant: Of course, I can help with that. Which room are you interested in knowing the temperature of?

query.User: I want to know the temperature in my living room.
query.Assistant: Sure, one moment while I fetch that information for you.

query.User: Once you get that, can you set the temperature of my bedroom to match that of the living room?
query.Assistant: Just to confirm, you'd like me to set the same temperature in your bedroom as your living room, correct?

query.User: Yes, that's what I asked for.

function.name: get_current_temperature
function.description: Retrieves the current ambient temperature from a specified location, such as a room, building, or outdoor environment.

location.description: The specified location, such as a room, building, or outdoor environment from where the current ambient temperature is to be retrieved.

function.name: check_door_status
function.description: Queries the status of a door to determine if it is currently open or closed, and may provide additional security information.

door_location.description: The location of the door that the user wants to check the status of

function.name: play_music
function.description: Initiates the playback of music on a connected audio system, including options to select playlists, songs, or streaming services.

song/playlist.description: The specific song or playlist that the user wants to play.

volume.description: The volume at which the music should be played.

music_service.description: The specific music or streaming service, e.g. Spotify.

location.description: The location where the user wants the music to be played.

music_genre.description: The specific genre of music the user wants to play.

function.name: lock_door
function.description: Commands a smart lock to secure a door, ensuring the door is locked and reporting the lock status.

door_name.description: The name or location of the door that needs to be locked

function.name: adjust_room_temperature
function.description: Controls the thermostat or heating/cooling system to set a specific temperature for a room or area.

temperature.description: The desired temperature to set the thermostat or heating/cooling system to.

location.description: The specific room or area where the temperature should be adjusted.

function.name: adjust_lighting
function.description: Modifies the lighting conditions in a specified area, which can include dimming, color changes, or turning lights on or off.

location.description: Specifies the area where the lighting conditions are to be modified

action.description: Determines the action to be executed on the specified lighting conditions such as turning on or off lights or dimming

intensity.description: Represents the level of brightness to be set if the lights are to be dimmed or brightened

function.name: adjust_music_volume
function.description: Changes the volume of the music currently being played on a connected audio system.

volume.description: A numerical representation of the desired music volume

function.name: GetWeather
function.description: Get the weather of a certain location on a date. The format for values of parameters related to date is "^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$", and for parameters related to time, it is "HH:MM". Values for parameters indicating yes or no should use the boolean type.
